ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a forest food web picture; at the lower right there is a green snake labeled “Snake”; at the lower left/lower middle there is a mouse labeled “Mouse.” In the picture there is a curved arrow from the mouse’s position pointing to the snake’s position. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually indicate energy flowing from the organism being eaten to the predator, that is, from the food to the consumer. Therefore, the arrow from Mouse to Snake indicates that the snake eats the mouse. So what the snake consumes is mouse.
